citations.narrative:
The facility's acquisition records are incomplete. The records did not include aquisitions for two Squirrel monkey's, one
White-faced capuchin, five pigs, or the transfer of four goats and one pig. Disposition records are missing the drivers
license of the purchaser, and the animal-on-hand record is missing rabbits.
Accurate and well-maintained records of acquisition and disposition of animals is critical to identify and trace animals and
to make sure all animals are accounted for.
Each dealer shall make, keep, and maintain records or forms which fully and correctly disclose acquisition and disposition
information regarding animals purchased or otherwise acquired, owned, held, leased, or otherwise in his or her
possession or under his or her control, or which is transported, sold, euthanized, or otherwise disposed of by that
exhibitor. The records shall include any offspring born or hatched. Correct by October 28, 2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
You may appeal all or part of any inspection report by submitting a written statement contesting the findings—along with
any supporting documentation—to the Deputy Administrator. Appeals of routine, focused, or attempted inspections must
be received within 21 days of report issuance as shown by the signature line of this report.
Appeals may be sent by email to AnimalCare@usda.gov.
Appeals sent by mail should be addressed to:
Deputy Administrator
APHIS Animal Care (AC)
U.S. Department of Agriculture
2150 Centre Avenue, Building B
Mailstop #3W11
Fort Collins, CO 80526-8117
